title: Cheats Coq au Vin Blanc
description: A simplified white wine coq au vin — chicken thighs, leeks, bacon and mushrooms braised in white wine stock with carrots and baby potatoes.
ingredients: chopped fresh parsley leaves, to serve
steps: Spray a large, flameproof casserole (with a lid) with oil and stir-fry the onion, leeks, bacon, garlic, mushrooms and chicken for 10 minutes.
Add the cornflour and some salt and pepper and stir together. Pour in the wine and the hot stock, then mix in the mustard, thyme, carrots and potatoes.
Stir everything together thoroughly, then place the lid on the casserole and cook on the middle shelf of the oven for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven, stir thoroughly and shred the tender chicken a bit so it disperses through the casserole.
Serve with a grind of pepper and some fresh parsley.
notes: Goes really well with green veg such as asparagus, green beans or broccoli. To keep it all in one pot, add vegetables at the end of cooking time, pop the lid back on and simmer on the hob for 5 minutes.
